data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in claims reserves for Treaty (2012 and prior years) reported in note; adverse development increased ultimate claims by the stated amount.
Increase in claims reserves for Liability (2012 and prior years) reported in note; adverse development in US liability increased ultimate claims by the stated amount.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the syndicate reported a gross strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 23.342m (around 8.37% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven primarily by adverse development on Liability (Casualty) and movement in the Treaty account relating to 2012 and prior years. The movement is explicitly shown in the notes as increases to ultimate claims reserves for Treaty (GBP 6.623m) and Liability (GBP 16.719m).
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased.
These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.
As mentioned above the majority of the loss for the year emanates from the liability line of business on the 2013 and prior years of account.
The result was affected by worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account and further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, comparative column). Prior year development derived from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly lists gross increases to ultimate claims reserves for Treaty and Liability (2012 & prior). No gross claims development triangle was found in the provided text; no specifically named catastrophe events were identified. Percentages rounded to two decimals. Amounts are in millions GBP.
